definitions: A beveled strip of material, typically wood or fiberboard, used at the junction of a flat roof and a parapet wall to provide a gradual transition and prevent sharp angles.
A triangular-shaped piece used in construction to eliminate a 90-degree angle, often seen in roofing applications.
examples: The roofer installed a cant strip at the base of the parapet.
We need to order more cant strips for the new building.
A cant strip helps ensure proper drainage on a flat roof.
